blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The NU Pep Squad emerged victorious anew on Saturday night as it successfully defended its crown in the UAAP Season 89 Cheerdance Competition at Mall of Asia Arena. NU clinched its second three-peat in school history, mirroring the squad’s achievement from 2012-2015. “All the people behind the NU Pep Squad have been very supportive. That’s really been our secret,” coach Gab Bajacan said after steering NU to a winning performance that registered 693.5 points. “They help out in every way they can to give our athletes what they deserve every time.” NU Pep Squad claimed a record-extending 10th title.
